reason: As someone burned by the first campaign and short on spare money, A answers my doubts directly: $11,000 more is already pledged so only $49,000 is left (just $2,000 over what we gave last time), it admits the roof cost risk and film-release limits, and promises quarterly spending reports plus a Thanksgiving reopening. B is clean and gives the refund guarantee, but leaves out those trust-building specifics.
